spans.s: घात m. 1. A blow, a stroke, a hit, देहि खरनयनशरघातम् Git.G.x.; 2. killing, hurting, destruction, slaughter, सदयहृदयदर्शितपशुघातम् Git.G.i., Yaj.ii.159, iii.252; 3. an arrow; 4. the product of a sum in multiplication.
घात-चंद्र m. the moon when in an inauspicious lunar mansion.
घात-तिथि f. an inauspicious lunar day.
घात-वार m. an inauspicious day of the week.
घात-स्थान n. a slaughter-house, a place of execution.
घातक a. (f. का) a killer, a destroyer, a murderer.

घातन (II) n. 1. Striking, killing, slaughter; 2. killing an animal at a sacrifice.
